title: NVIDIA/NemoClaw — Run OpenClaw securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell with managed inference

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this: OpenClaw is now running securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell with managed inference — and it's blowing up on GitHub.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This matters because secure, managed AI inference is critical as more companies adopt open-source models in production.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: NemoClaw lets you run OpenClaw inside NVIDIA OpenShell with full security and control — no more messy setups.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The standout feature? It uses NVIDIA's managed inference to handle resource allocation and model execution automatically.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects developers and enterprises using OpenClaw who need security, scalability, and performance without the overhead.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: NVIDIA is making it easier to run open-source models securely at scale — and it's already a hit with devs.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Check out NemoClaw on GitHub — what’s your take on secure AI inference?
